rating_source: localheadspa.com detail page (https://localheadspa.com/salons/palms-salon-head-spa-60593), fetched directly: '5 (23 reviews)', 'Data checked on 10 July 2026'. This aggregator sources its listing directly from the business's Google Business Profile: its own page includes a 'Google Maps' button linking to the specific place_id ChIJzwNGcp313ogRHpymYMao-UI, and its 'Visit website' button (labelled from the GBP website field) links to https://instagram.com/palmssalonandheadspa, independently corroborating the task brief's claim that Google's own website field for this business points to Instagram (see own_site_check). Direct independent re-verification was attempted but blocked by tooling: Google Search and Google Maps pages render via JS and returned no readable rating text to WebFetch/curl; no Yelp, Birdeye or Nextdoor listing exists for this specific Fort Pierce business (checked all three; only unrelated same-name businesses in other cities/states appeared, e.g. Birdeye listings for 'The Palms Hair Salon and Spa' in Boynton Beach FL and 'Palms Salon' in New York NY, both ruled out as different businesses); the Vagaro reviews page (vagaro.com/palmssuite/reviews) returns a live HTTP 404 (see booking_platform_note). 5.0/23 clears the >=4.5 rating and >=10 review bar to proceed.
own_site_check: Checked and ruled out: palmssalon.com (resolves, but is a HugeDomains parking/for-sale page, confirmed via curl: title 'PalmsSalon.com is for sale | HugeDomains'), palmsheadspa.com / palmssalonandheadspa.com / palmssalonheadspa.com / palmssalonspa.com (all fail to resolve, curl exit 000/'could not resolve host' equivalent). The Instagram bio external_url (fetched via the IG web_profile_info endpoint, i.instagram.com/api/v1/users/web_profile_info) is https://palmssalonspa.comb.works/, a Comb booking-platform subdomain, which per pipeline rules does NOT count as an own domain. localheadspa.com's 'Visit website' button (sourced from the Google Business Profile's own website field) points to https://instagram.com/palmssalonandheadspa, i.e. Google's own listing has NO real website on file either, independently corroborating the task brief's stated no-website signal. Also checked: 'The Palms Salon & Day Spa' (thepalmssalon.club) surfaced in search results but was confirmed to be a completely unrelated business in Edgewater, FL (501 N Ridgewood Ave, phone (386) 444-6065), ruled out.

booking_platform_note: Both booking URLs given in the task brief are DEAD / superseded: vagaro.com/palmssuite and all its subpaths (/reviews, /styles, /services) return a live HTTP 404 'Page not found' from Vagaro itself (confirmed via curl and WebFetch), and it no longer appears in Vagaro's own Fort Pierce category listing search; palmssalonheadspa.comb.works also returns a live HTTP 404 (generic Laravel 404 page). The REAL, currently active booking platform, found via the Instagram bio's external_url, is https://palmssalonspa.comb.works/ (Comb booking software; HTTP 200, real content, matches the business's own name/address/phone/hours/services). All CTAs on the built site point to https://palmssalonspa.comb.works/booking. Comb is a booking-platform subdomain, not an owned domain (has_own_site stays false).
services_note: Full real menu with exact names, durations and prices pulled directly from https://palmssalonspa.comb.works/services (server-rendered text, first-party, category 'Hair Color And Head Spa' = 16 services + category 'Extensions' = 1 service = 17 total). All 17 listed below; the site groups them into 4 featured cards (Luxury Head Spa signature; Classic/Lite/Bond Repair/Balancing Head Spa; Custom Color & Balayage; Cuts & Extensions) plus a footnote for the remaining smaller add-ons (Toner/Glaze, Bang trim, Curl/Style, free consultations), per the no-accordion / no-invented-copy quality gate rule for larger menus.
payments_note: Google Pay, Apple Pay, Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, AfterPay, Affirm, Venmo, Zelle, Cash (per the booking page's own Info/FAQ panel). Appointment only, no walk-ins. Cancellation: no fees for cancellations or no-shows, but advance notice appreciated.
reviews_note: ZERO individually-attributed verbatim reviews with author names were recoverable after an exhaustive search, despite the real, well-corroborated 5.0/23 aggregate rating (see rating_source). Checked and exhausted: (1) vagaro.com/palmssuite/reviews returns a live HTTP 404 from Vagaro itself (the platform listing is gone/renamed, only a stale Google-index summary phrase without any reviewer name surfaced in one WebSearch call, not usable without a name); (2) Google Maps/Search render reviews via JS only, no readable review text returned to WebFetch or curl; (3) no Yelp listing exists for this business in Fort Pierce (checked directly and via search); (4) no Birdeye listing exists for this specific business/city (only unrelated same-name businesses elsewhere); (5) no Nextdoor business page found; (6) Facebook page reviews/recommendations tab returns only a login-wall SPA shell with no review text in the fetched HTML. Per the no-invention rule, the site does NOT show a testimonials/quotes section (the template's 'Opiniones' section was removed rather than filled with fabricated names); the real 5.0/23 Google rating is still shown prominently in the hero, trust strip and About section, since that aggregate figure IS independently well-sourced (see rating_source).
brand_vibe: Real venue photos (Instagram interior shots) show a distinctive dark 'black jungle canopy' look: black-painted walls, a tropical green leaf-print accent wall, a hot-pink neon 'Hello Gorgeous' sign, black cabinetry with gold hardware, and a gold-on-dark-wood 'PS Palms Salon & Head Spa' logo sign with a palm-frond mark. This is NOT a light/botanical spa look (no cream, no pastel) and not a plain gold-luxury look either.
palette_note: "Palm noir": dark base (bg #120f0c, matches the real black walls) with accent-deep = deep palm/jungle green #4a6b42 (drives text-shine and the main buttons; taken from the real leaf-print wallpaper visible in the venue photos) and accent-mid = antique brass gold #c9973f (drives the marquee stars, cursor ring and secondary accents; taken from the real gold logo sign). Built from templates/dark-v2/index.html (pureartistry skeleton, itself gold #d4a84b/#b8934a on near-black) via a full hue-and-role swap: the roles of accent-deep/accent-mid were intentionally exchanged (green becomes primary instead of gold) so the site's dominant visual identity reads as green+gold rather than gold-only. Checked against templates/SKELETONS-V2.md's already-used list (coral fairy #c04e62, caramelo #a86a2e, esmeralda #2f7d5a, teal acero #4fb8b8, violeta dark #b18ae8, rosa dark, gold dark original #d4a84b/#b8934a) and is distinct from all of them; also intentionally different from any plausible light-botanical or teal palette a sibling head-spa build in this same batch might use, since this one commits to a dark base with a green+gold identity instead. The merktop-badge's own gold (#D4A84B uppercase, and its internal glow rgbas) was protected via block-extraction before the palette swap and is untouched, per pipeline rule (badge always stays gold).

photos.source_note: All real, from the business's own Instagram feed (@palmssalonandheadspa), pulled via the i.instagram.com web_profile_info JSON payload (edge_owner_to_timeline_media, 12 most recent posts: 3 photos, 7 videos, 1 sidecar carousel with 2 extra photos = 13 media items). The ig-photo-service Railway microservice (scripts/ig_photos.py) was tried first and worked once (12 items) then returned only 1-2 items on repeat calls in the same session (likely IG rate-limiting the service's shared IP), so the already-fetched web_profile_info JSON (used originally for the bio/external_url check) was reused directly as the photo source, expanding its GraphSidecar post's children for extra volume, per pipeline guidance. One post (bk-1, a Reels-style screenshot with UI icons/hearts overlay and a person posing) was discarded as a personal/selfie-style shot, per the no-selfie-in-gallery rule. build_note: Built from templates/dark-v2/index.html (pureartistry skeleton) via scripts/build_palmssalonheadspafortpierce.py, an anchored assert-then-replace transformation script (one Python file, asserts on every rep(), merktop-badge CSS block protected via extraction before the palette swap). Because zero attributable verbatim Google reviews were recoverable (see reviews_note), the template's 'Opiniones' testimonials section was removed entirely rather than filled with invented names or unattributed quotes; the nav links (desktop + mobile) to #opiniones were removed and the Ubicacion section's sec-num was renumbered from 06 to 05 to keep the numbering continuous. Services grid and gallery grid were replaced via regex per templates/SKELETONS-V2.md's recipe. GATE OK on the first full pass: `python3 scripts/gate.py palms-salon-head-spa-fort-pierce --lang en --forbid "Pure Artistry,Orlando,Booksy,booksy,121705,silk press,Silk Press,K-Tip,Locs,knotless,Chianita"`. Verified with Playwright (local venv, headless Chromium) at 1440px and 390px viewports: zero horizontal overflow at either width, zero JS console errors (only expected offline-sandbox failures: Google Fonts and the ig-photo-service could not be reached, both harmless / not present in the shipped page), JSON-LD parses valid, zero em-dashes. All 9 real photos confirmed to load correctly in the live DOM (complete=true, correct naturalWidth, 'loaded' class present) after a real scroll interaction; an initial QA screenshot taken via programmatic `scrollTo` calls showed several sections and gallery tiles as blank, which was diagnosed and confirmed to be purely a headless-screenshot/reveal-animation-timing artifact of that specific verification method (IntersectionObserver reveals + a CSS `scale` transition need a real scroll/paint cycle), not a real defect: re-verified with actual mouse-wheel scrolling and with prefers-reduced-motion emulation, both of which render every section and every gallery photo correctly.
